names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Александр (Волков), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Александра ... пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров (1918).»

attestations.note: The day’s seventh entry, a line of two men; THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS, no life page standing behind either. The line says «пресвитеров» and the name page «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are the source’s own words; `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. A Cyrillic grep for «Волков» over every `saint.json` returns `demetrius-volkov` and `vladimir-volkov` — two other forenames and two other days — and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page carries no troparion and no kontakion under this name; the three it prints belong to the day’s own feasts and to one of its icons.
